reason: A DSH Web composer plugin for browsing, restoring, and managing prior prompt history across conversations and restarts using local plain-text JSONL storage.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话输入框中用方向键浏览并恢复历史 prompt，并将纯文本历史跨会话和重启保存在本地。
summaries.en: A DSH Web composer plugin that lets users browse and restore prompt history with arrow keys while persisting plain-text entries locally across conversations and restarts.

capabilities: Captures submitted prompts and cleared drafts from the DSH Web composer
Persists plain-text prompt history in a local JSONL file
Intercepts selected Arrow and Escape key events in the composer
Provides controls to clear stored history
